inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A close patch of the camp of the last five survivors of a cult of cyborg flesh beings, an intergalactic species from a Type 4 civilization, on a bare high plateau of tan stone: pieces of the emergency kit that unfolded when they landed. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "compact sacred alien technology, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Clear cold morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes.", "color_palette": ["#d4c4a4", "#b0a084", "#7c7480", "#2e2c38", "#f2a24a", "#ece4ee", "#a898b8", "#e0a070", "#4a2350", "#a050e0", "#78dcff", "#aa6ef0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "flat bare warm tan stone of the plateau, wind scoured and cracked, seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [193, 300, 512, 417], "desc": "a regeneration tank of their alien technology: a tall glass cylinder full of glowing violet fluid on a dark gunmetal base with orange glyph seams, a pearly shell cap with a rose gold rim, a spare mechanical arm floating inside it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [375, 171, 518, 273], "desc": "three small power cells of their alien technology standing together: dark gunmetal frames with glowing cyan cores and pearly shell caps"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [812, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "flat bare warm tan stone of the plateau, wind scoured and cracked"}]}}
